title: Settling Conjectures 10.1, 10.2 and 10.3 on alternating plane graphs
description:
Settles three of the four open problems in Section 10 of Althöfer, Haugland, Scherer, Schneider & Van Cleemput, Alternating plane graphs, Ars Math. Contemp. 8 (2015) 337–363.

Results

Problem

Status

Conjecture 10.1
no 2,Y- and no X,2-APG

Proved, and not resting on an interpretation. Definition 2.1 is silent about bridges; the paper rules them out a few lines later by asserting that an APG is always 2-edge-connected, “since plane graph with edge connectivity 1 contains a face that is adjacent to itself” (p. 339). The proof here does not use that sentence — it closes under the permissive reading too, in which bridges are allowed.

Conjecture 10.2
(3,4,5)-APGs for all n ≥ 20

Settled. Certificates for all 26 previously open orders, plus a proved periodic capping lemma generating order 48 and every order n ≥ 50. Together these close every order n ≥ 46 without reference to the source paper; orders 20–45 remain that paper's own heuristic and Section-8 coverage and are not re-established here.

Conjecture 10.3
3-connected APG for all n ≥ 19

Settled. A verified 3-connected witness at every order from 19 up.

Fourth problem
asymptotic degree distribution

Open. The distribution of v4/v3 on [1, 1.5]. Out of reach of these methods; the deposit explains why.

Also included: a (3,4,5)-alternating plane graph on 46 vertices with a separating pair, refuting the natural shortcut that every such graph is 3-connected.

Verification

Measure

Value

Gates

1257 passed, 13 skipped

Runtime

about 11 minutes (Python 3.9.6, macOS)

Dependencies of the settled results

Python standard library only

Independent verifiers per certificate

3

Run it with make deps && make verify. Certificates store rotation systems only: no file records a claim that a graph is an alternating plane graph, and every derived property is recomputed on each run by three independently written decision procedures. Each gate is paired with a control that must fail, so a check cannot pass by being vacuous.

Honest limits

  • The manuscript in paper/ compiles and ships as an 11-page PDF, but it is a draft that has had no peer review.
  • Three claims made in this work were false and were withdrawn, plus a certificate misidentified as not 3-connected. All are recorded at the files that made them rather than quietly deleted; see REVIEW.md.
  • No third-party bytes are redistributed. No licence statement was found at the source of the published corpus, so each of its graphs is re-expressed in this repository's own format, with the digest of every original preserved for verification.
  • AI assistance was substantial, including the step that makes Conjecture 10.1 unconditional. No AI system is an author. See AI_DISCLOSURE.md.

Start with ARTIFACT.md; ZENODO.md is a formatted summary of this deposit.
